title: fix: set the correct name for menu-bar popup
description: The fix in 7e3e8c6015f1ce93232df474680b5f31029e9701 broke the menu-bar popup for `quarto-preview`. This fix re-enable the popup with the correct keymap's name.

title: Add a customization for quarto preview to watch inputs
description:
Hi,

Here is a PR to fix #5. It simply adds a custom variable `quarto-preview-watch-inputs` and changes the process call accordingly. The process call is not very elegant as I don't know how to deal with empty strings in the command, but it works.

title: Simple fixes for checkdoc and byte compiler
